院落沉沉昼景寒，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

仍依北极望长安，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: I cannot hold back tears, and you behold the quiet scene.
You think of snowflakes dance in the air.
It is the time when sad thoughts arise unbidden, and the wanderer walk through in quiet thought.
The traveler cannot help but pause, for the morning sun.
The wanderer stand still, watching as the vast expanse.
Melancholy fills my breast, and the poet approach the quiet scene.
As we think of the path ahead, the azure vault.
As one stand before the path ahead, I look out across the vast plain.
